title: ConvergerConnectorOptions
description: Constructor options for ConvergerConnector — the Converger channel hub client (Converger Protocol v1, a superset of mekik/1). Every MekikConnectorOptions field applies unchanged; the Converger-only ones follow. Source: packages/connector-converger/src/index.ts.

protocols.description: Sub-protocol(s) passed to the WebSocket constructor. Default ["converger.v1"]: the full protocol (acks, receipts, presence). Offering none would get the mekik/1 profile.

reconnect.description: Auto-reconnect when the socket closes. Suppressed after an auth rejection (close code 4401).

reconnectDelay.description: Milliseconds to wait between reconnect attempts.

maxReconnectAttempts.description: Stop reconnecting after this many consecutive failures. Reset on a successful handshake.

reconnectBackoff.description: Reconnect pacing: "fixed" waits reconnectDelay every time; "exponential" grows the wait geometrically up to reconnectMaxDelay with full jitter.

routeInUrl.description: Put conversationId (and userId) in the connect URL query string — Converger treats them as hints for a load balancer that routes by conversation.

queueOfflineMessages.description: Queue outgoing messages while the socket is down and flush them on (re)connect.

userId.description: Stable user identity sent in the hello handshake. Omit to let the server mint one (announced via the welcome frame). An authenticating server may override this with the verified identity.

conversationId.description: Conversation to resume. Omit to start a new one.

resumeConversation.description: Persist identity + watermark in localStorage and resume across page reloads.

auth.description: MekikAuthProvider adapter (TokenAuth, CookieAuth or custom) for a Converger token from POST /api/v1/converger/tokens/generate, minted by your backend. Its token also authorizes the REST calls (upload, history, reactions, conversation list). Cannot be serialised — set programmatically. Takes precedence over `token`.

token.description: Deprecated — shorthand for `auth: new TokenAuth({ token, maxRetries: 0 })`: a credential sent in the hello handshake with no retry on rejection. A function returning a fresh token per attempt is also accepted, but cannot be serialised — set that programmatically. Not needed for cookie-based auth.

onAuthError.description: Callback invoked when the server rejects the connection (error frame + close code 4401). Cannot be serialised — set programmatically.

tools.description: Client tools declared to the server (mekik PROTOCOL.md §11): {name, description?, parameters?, tags?, mode?, handler}. Each entry carries a handler function, so the option cannot be serialised — set programmatically. Ignored by servers that did not opt in.

allowDynamicTools.description: Allow registerTool()/unregisterTool() after construction. Off by default: with the default the toolset is sealed at construction and held in true-private fields, so injected script cannot rewire what the server-side model may trigger.

skills.description: Client skills declared to the server (mekik PROTOCOL.md §12.4): inline SKILL.md-style instructions a server-side model follows when the task matches. Sent in the hello handshake and re-declared on every (re)connect. Ignored entirely by servers that did not opt in (MekikOptions.clientSkills).

allowDynamicSkills.description: Allow registerSkill()/unregisterSkill() after construction. Off by default: a skill's description and instructions are text a server-side model will follow, so with the default the set is sealed at construction and held in true-private fields.

apiUrl.description: Converger client API base. Default: derived from `url` (same host, ws→http, wss→https, path /api/v1/converger).

channelScoped.description: The auth provider yields a channel-scoped token (agent consoles). REST list/create/close use it; each conversation socket uses a conversation-bound token exchanged via GET /conversations/:id. No socket opens until a conversation is chosen.

historyPageSize.description: Frames per loadHistory page (GET .../activities?direction=backward&format=frames). The newest page comes over REST and the socket replays only newer frames. 0 turns REST history off (the socket replays the whole transcript).

ackTimeout.description: Milliseconds sendMessage waits for the server ack before the message is marked failed. 0 waits forever.

maxSendRetries.description: How many times a send refused with a retryable error (rate_limited, too_many_in_flight, unavailable, …) is re-sent with the same clientId.

readReceipts.description: Send read receipts ({type:"read", watermark}) for the other side’s messages while the widget is open.

feedbackReactions.description: The reaction text sendFeedback posts as a messageReaction activity.
